Your earnings

Rs. 3,078,000

Gross minus commission. Derived, never stored as a separate figure that could disagree.

How this is calculated. commission_amount = total_amount × 10.00% and your earnings = total_amount − commission_amount. The rate is snapshotted on each booking when it is placed, so a future change to the platform rate never rewrites past earnings. Only completed bookings appear here — pending, accepted, rejected and cancelled bookings have earned nothing yet.
